MOLN.title: Molecular Partners Presents New Preclinical Data for Next-Generation T Cell Engager MP0632 at SITC 2026

PHAR.title: MHRA approves Pharming’s Joenja® (leniolisib) as first treatment specifically for children with APDS in the U.K.
PHAR.summary: The U.K. Medicines and Healthcare products Regulatory Agency (MHRA) has approved an extension of Pharming's Joenja® (leniolisib) to treat children aged 4 to 11 years weighing at least 27kg with activated PI3K delta syndrome (APDS), a rare primary immunodeficiency. This marks the first treatment approved in the U.K. specifically for children with APDS, with availability expected in February 2027. The approval is supported by clinical data from Pharming's pediatric clinical program.

CATX.summary: Perspective Therapeutics announced positive Phase 1/2a trial data for bamzireotide navoxetan (VMT-α-NET) in neuroendocrine tumor patients. The system features enhanced throughput, automation, and data consistency capabilities, with approximately 40% faster acquisition time for plate-based workflows and automated startup/shutdown functions to improve laboratory efficiency.

STRW.title: Strawberry Fields Reit Announces Third Quarter 2026 Operating Results
STRW.summary: Strawberry Fields REIT (STRW) reported Q3 2026 results showing a net loss of $14.7 million, primarily driven by a $24.6 million foreign currency transaction loss from bond redemptions. Despite the quarterly loss, the company collected 100% of contractual rents and completed acquisitions totaling $10.4 million in Kansas City with additional $15 million Angola facility pending. Nine-month AFFO per share improved to $1.00 from $0.96 year-over-year.

STRW.title: Strawberry Fields REIT Announces Q4 2026 Cash Dividend of $0.17 Per Common Share
STRW.summary: Strawberry Fields REIT, Inc. (NYSE AMERICAN: STRW) announced a cash dividend of $0.17 per share, payable on December 30, 2026, to stockholders of record as of December 16, 2026. The REIT owns and operates 145 healthcare facilities with over 15,600 beds across 10 states, comprising primarily skilled nursing facilities, assisted living facilities, and other healthcare-related properties.

RIO.title: Entrée Resources Announces Third Quarter 2026 Results
RIO.summary: Entrée Resources Ltd. closed a non-brokered private placement of 12.5 million units at C$2.90 per unit, raising C$36.2 million with participation from a Tether affiliate. The company continues negotiations with Mongolia's government on state participation in its Shivee Tolgoi and Javkhlant mining licences and the transfer of these licences to joint venture partner Oyu Tolgoi LLC. Rio Tinto reported Oyu Tolgoi copper production increased 29% year-to-date with underground operations ramping up on track.

CGAU.title: Centerra Gold Announces TSX Acceptance of Renewed Normal Course Issuer Bid  and New $75 Million Langeloth Credit Facility
CGAU.summary: Centerra Gold announced TSX acceptance of its renewed normal course issuer bid (NCIB) to purchase up to 19.3 million common shares over the next 12 months, representing 10% of public float. The company also announced a new $75 million working capital credit facility for its Langeloth Metallurgical Facility to support molybdenum operations and reduce reliance on parent company funding.

QNTM.summary: Quantum BioPharma Ltd. filed a supplement to its management information circular ahead of its November 10, 2026 shareholder meeting, correcting the treatment of fractional shares in a proposed consolidation of its class A multiple voting shares and class B subordinate voting shares. The company also clarified that MVS holders' voting power will be capped at 70% if their aggregate voting power would otherwise exceed this threshold due to share cancellations.

BMR.title: Beamr (NASDAQ: BMR) CEO Issues Statement: From Infrastructure Accelerator to AI Capacity Multiplier
BMR.summary: Beamr Imaging CEO Sharon Carmel released a letter addressing the recent semiconductor and data-center stock selloff, noting that potential constraints on US data-center capacity expansion could create scarcity in AI infrastructure. The company positions its video compression technology as a capacity multiplier that can effectively double data capacity and transfer throughput for video-intensive AI workloads, turning infrastructure limitations into a strategic advantage for Beamr.

OMDA.title: New York Academy of Medicine Names Leaders from Hospital for Special Surgery and Omada Health to Board of Trustees
OMDA.summary: The New York Academy of Medicine announced two new Board of Trustees members: Ann Marie McDonald, senior vice president and chief nursing executive at Hospital for Special Surgery, and Thomas Tsang, chief medical officer at Omada Health. Both leaders bring extensive expertise in healthcare quality, clinical operations, and technology-enabled care delivery.

ANTW.title: Elon Musk’s AI Rival Agreed to Pay Him $1.25 Billion a Month.
ANTW.summary: Anthropic agreed to pay SpaceX approximately $1.25 billion monthly for computing power through May 2029, totaling nearly $45 billion. The deal grants Anthropic access to SpaceX's Colossus data centers in Memphis. Analyst James Altucher argues this reflects Musk's broader strategy to control the AI industry vertically—from computing infrastructure to satellite deployment—similar to Rockefeller's oil industry consolidation.

TLSA.title: Tiziana to Host Investor Call with Key Opinion Leaders to Discuss Positive Phase 2a INFORM-MS Topline Results
TLSA.summary: Tiziana Life Sciences announced positive Phase 2a results from its INFORM-MS trial of intranasal foralumab for non-active secondary progressive multiple sclerosis (na-SPMS). The trial met its primary endpoint with statistically significant reduction in microglial activation (p=0.0168) at the 50μg dose and showed clinically meaningful fatigue improvements in both dose arms after 12 weeks. The company will host an investor call with key opinion leaders on November 9, 2026, to discuss the results and plans to engage with the FDA regarding next steps.

KMX.summary: A new community-built playground opened at Equally Created in Nashville on November 5, 2026, designed by kids and built by volunteers from the community, CarMax Foundation, and KABOOM!. The playspace will serve 140 students and is part of KABOOM!'s nationwide effort to end playspace inequity. CarMax Foundation provided majority funding and employee volunteers, while KABOOM! continues its 30-year mission to transform playspaces and advance children's physical and mental health.

WCCPD.title: War Labs Unveils Plan to Build an American Defense Technology and Manufacturing Platform
WCCPD.summary: War Labs Defense Technologies (OTC: WCCPD) announced a strategic plan to develop an American defense technology platform combining patented electroshock non-lethal ammunition with U.S. drone production and counter-UAS capabilities. The company aims to advance its untethered ammunition technology, establish domestic manufacturing operations, and pursue licensing partnerships with established defense manufacturers. The company is in the development stage with no definitive manufacturing agreements or binding production contracts currently in place.

SWDBY.title: Swedbank Provides EUR 130 Million in Financing to Akropolis Group
SWDBY.summary: Akropolis Group, a leading Baltic real estate developer, has secured a EUR 130 million seven-year credit facility with Swedbank to refinance its previous loan. The agreement reflects strong financial performance, with H1 2026 consolidated revenue reaching EUR 81.6 million (up 29%) and EBITDA of EUR 56.6 million (up 28%). The company maintains BB+ credit ratings from both S&P Global and Fitch, and continues expansion through its shopping centres and residential development segment Galio Group.

SWDBY.title: „Swedbank“ suteikė 130 mln. eurų finansavimą bendrovei „Akropolis Group“
SWDBY.summary: Akropolis Group, a leading real estate development and management company in the Baltic states, has signed a €130 million 7-year credit agreement with Swedbank to refinance previous debt and support long-term investments and expansion projects. COST.title: WSWA Announces Program Highlights for Access LIVE 2027
COST.summary: WSWA announced programming highlights for Access LIVE 2027, a major industry conference taking place February 1-4, 2027, in Dallas, Texas. The event will feature keynote remarks from WSWA leadership, industry trend analysis, retail perspectives, an 11th annual Brand Battle competition, and educational sessions focused on wine, spirits, and beverage alcohol business strategies. NVA.title: Faster Permitting Paths Put Gold-Antimony Projects on Both Sides of the Pacific in Focus
NVA.summary: With China's antimony export suspension set to expire in November 2026 and global antimony prices elevated, governments in New Zealand and the United States are accelerating approvals for gold-antimony projects. RUA GOLD submitted its substantive application for the Auld Creek project in New Zealand under the Fast-track Approvals Act, targeting mid-2027 approvals. Nova Minerals received final permits for its Alaska antimony project with $43.4 million in Department of War funding, targeting 2027 production. United States Antimony Corporation began mining operations at Nolan Creek, while Perpetua Resources secured $40 million in additional U.S. Army funding for tungsten evaluation at Stibnite. Alkane Resources reported strong Q1 FY27 production of 39,823 ounces of gold and 396 tonnes of antimony.

AIR aims to establish a regulated presence in the U.S. vaping market as an alternative to combustible cigarettes.

CLGN.title: LightSolver Secures ~$1.8 Million Grant from Israel’s Innovation Authority to Advance its Laser Processing Unit (LPU)
CLGN.summary: LightSolver, a subsidiary of CollPlant Biotechnologies, has secured approximately $1.8 million in grant funding from Israel's Innovation Authority to advance its Laser Processing Unit (LPU), an all-optical laser-based computing platform. The program aims to develop next-generation LPU hardware for solving partial differential equations, expand algorithmic capabilities, and integrate the LPU into high-performance computing environments. This grant builds on LightSolver's recent momentum, including strategic partnerships with Boeing and the Israel Ministry of Defense, peer-reviewed research, and a growing IP portfolio.

OR.title: Northern Discovery Metals Completes Acquisition of the Cibola Copper-Gold Project in British Columbia
OR.summary: Northern Discovery Metals Inc. has completed the acquisition of a 100% interest in the Cibola copper-gold project in British Columbia from Orogen Royalties Inc. The property comprises 3,567 hectares located 90 km south-southwest of Houston and is situated in a region with porphyry copper deposits. The company paid $30,000 upfront, issued 100,000 common shares, and granted a 2% net smelter returns royalty, with additional milestone payments tied to drilling permits and completion of feasibility studies.

SHEL.title: Transaction in Own Shares
SHEL.summary: Shell plc announced the purchase of approximately 1.88 million shares for cancellation on November 4, 2026, as part of its share buyback program initiated on October 29, 2026. The shares were purchased across multiple trading venues in GBP and EUR at prices ranging from £37.98 to £38.82 and €45.70 to €46.72 respectively. The program, managed by BNP Paribas and Natixis, will continue through January 29, 2027, in compliance with UK and EU market regulations.

The company commenced construction at Moses Lake, expected to generate HPC revenue in 2027, and advanced permitting at Sharon and Panther Creek sites. With $780M in liquidity and no immediate financing needs, Keel is negotiating leases with multiple creditworthy parties across three near-term sites.

KVHI.title: KVH Industries Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results
KVHI.summary: KVH Industries reported strong Q3 2026 results with total revenue up 35% YoY to $38.4 million and service revenue up 30% to $33.0 million, driven by LEO subscriber growth. The company narrowed its full-year 2026 outlook to $137-143 million revenue and $13-15 million adjusted EBITDA, raising the low end. LEO now represents 58% of service revenue, up from 39% a year ago. KVH ended the quarter with $50.7 million in cash and no debt.

PMN.title: ProMIS Neurosciences to Participate in Upcoming Conferences in November
PMN.summary: ProMIS Neurosciences Inc. announced its participation in multiple healthcare conferences throughout November 2026, including presentations and fireside chats by CEO Neil Warma at venues in Boston, New York, and London. The company will present interim safety and biomarker analysis data from its PRECISE-AD trial at the Clinical Trials on Alzheimer's Disease conference.

TGLS.title: Tecnoglass Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results
TGLS.summary: Tecnoglass Holdings Inc. reported record third quarter 2026 revenues of $310.6 million, up 19.2% year-over-year, driven by 31% growth in multi-family and commercial business. However, gross margins contracted significantly due to elevated aluminum costs, tariffs, and a stronger Colombian Peso. The company raised full-year 2026 revenue guidance to $1.10-1.14 billion while adjusting Adjusted EBITDA guidance to $210-220 million, reflecting an $8.4 million non-cash inventory revaluation impact.

GLUE.title: Monte Rosa Therapeutics Announces Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Business Updates
GLUE.summary: Monte Rosa Therapeutics announced positive Phase 1 results for MRT-8102, showing significant NEK7 degradation and reduction in cardiovascular disease markers with safety comparable to placebo. The company plans to initiate three Phase 2 studies in gout, coronary artery disease, and hidradenitis suppurativa. Cohort 1 showed favorable safety and clinically meaningful improvements in visual function across all five participants.

PRVA.summary: Privia Health Group announced robust third-quarter 2026 financial results with YTD net income of $25.6M (+85.9%) and adjusted EBITDA of $114.7M (+21.9%). The company continues its share repurchase program with $115 million remaining under authorization.

PRM.summary: Perimeter Group Inc. (formerly Perimeter Solutions) reported third quarter 2026 net sales of $389.9M, up 24% year-over-year, with net income of $304.5M and adjusted EBITDA of $223.5M. The company completed the Monaco Enterprises acquisition for $117.1M and demonstrated strong performance across both Fire Safety and Specialty Products segments, with Specialty Products net sales surging 84%.

LFST.summary: LifeStance Health Group announced Q3 2026 financial results with revenue of $455.9 million, up 25% year-over-year, and net income of $22.4 million compared to $1.1 million in Q3 2025. The company raised its full-year 2026 guidance across all metrics, including revenue to $1.741-$1.761 billion and Adjusted EBITDA to $242-$250 million. The clinician base grew 11% to 8,863, and visit volumes increased 17% to 2.7 million.

CGTX.summary: Cognition Therapeutics reported Q3 2026 financial results with a net loss of $4.1 million. With $31.5 million in cash and $18.2 million in grant funds, the company estimates sufficient funding into Q4 2027.
